resourcePlanning.title: Resource planning
resourcePlanning.subtitle: Weekly team utilization: planned project hours vs. available capacity.
resourcePlanning.empty: No planning data for this range.
resourcePlanning.employeesIntro: Choose who counts toward total capacity and set each person’s share of capacity spent on project work (%).
resourcePlanning.projectsIntro: Manage annual project budgets and intensive phases. A phase can be assigned to a person.
resourcePlanning.confirmDeleteBudget: Delete this project budget and its phases?
resourcePlanning.noBudgets: No project budgets for this year.
resourcePlanning.noPhases: No phases – the budget is spread evenly across the year.
resourcePlanning.assigneeHelp: Assign to a person: these hours reduce their capacity instead of adding to project load.
resourcePlanning.balanceIntro: Per project: base hours/week, hours from intensive phases, and the projected hour balance at year end.
resourcePlanning.saldoHint: Saldo = remaining credit hours − planned load (base + intensive phases) over the {weeks} remaining weeks. Negative = budget likely to be exceeded.
resourcePlanning.closuresIntro: Date ranges where nobody works. Load is redistributed to open weeks and the fixed weekly load is 0.
resourcePlanning.defaultLoadsIntro: Recurring weekly tasks that reserve capacity (e.g. support, admin).
resourcePlanning.assigneesHelp: Split across one or more people (share in %). Empty = whole team.
resourcePlanning.assigneesHint: Shares need not total 100% — they are weighted relatively.
